name: Pad woon sen with shrimp
notes: Rachel Cooks Thai pad woonsen (4 plates: 120 g dry glass noodles, 1/2 cup chicken, 2 eggs, 1/2 cup carrots, 1 tbsp each of oyster and thin soy sauce) and RecipeTin Eats' pad woon sen. Per plate 40 g of dry noodles, which take up about 110 g of water; oil 15 g; protein is the cooked weight.
